reveal.rows_exactly: Byte-semantically identical in ordering and values to sealed_blind_map.rows: {fixture_id,opaque_id,content_hash,correct_answer,expected_valid}

custody_artifacts.role_separation: Author differs from blind and explanation reviewers; novelty has an independent reviewer identity. A blind reviewer receives only exact key-free candidate content/evidence.

sealed_answer_disclosure.independent_review_answer_custody: Blind solution derives its own key and all four option judgments from the candidate and supplied evidence; it receives no author key, label, explanation, defect annotation, or candidate ID.

semantic_novelty.compare_against: All hash-custodied prior benchmark, qualification, regression, pilot, candidate-bank, and previously exposed generation history relevant to these subjects; do not limit comparison to the most recent q1/q2/q3/pilot source-reference lists.
semantic_novelty.history_binding: Every history file used is listed in novelty_report.compared_history with exact SHA-256; novelty reviewer confirms each hash before review.
per_fixture_analysis: semantic learning objective and underlying fact/rule
numeric or categorical structure and distractor misconception
semantic_novelty.decision: A changed value, entity, source citation, wording, or option order does not make the same idea novel. Compare meaning and solution path; mark unique:false and hold for a different objective if an equivalent prior idea exists. Explain the nearest historical neighbor for each fixture.

difficulty_guard.medium: Use medium only for ordinary CUET demand in its usual question format: the student must apply an entitled concept, interpret a short passage, distinguish plausible syllabus concepts, or link a modest number of reasoning steps. Do not label a definition lookup, obvious lexical-root match, one-step warm-up, or value-changed copy as medium.
difficulty_guard.english: Do not fill the English quota with trivial standalone lexical-root/definition lookups. Select meaningful reading-comprehension or verbal-ability tasks with ordinary CUET-level inference, context, phrase ordering, matching, or word choice; keep all language evidence explicit and the passage answerable. Easy is allowed only when honestly labeled and useful as a warm-up; medium must meet actual CUET cognitive demand.
difficulty_guard.hard: Optional only when independently established as materially above usual CUET demand while within syllabus and time.
